release.selection_basis: development labels only; maximize MRR + .25 Hit@5 + .5 no-answer accuracy; ties prefer weights nearest prespecified default, then deterministic order
release.formula: S = w_name*name_similarity + w_alias*nickname_similarity + w_sem*weighted_keyword_similarity + .04*base/kind_prior; filters are hard constraints; require minimum lexical confidence or full semantic constraints, then S >= threshold

D.scope: uncached full query parsing, candidate generation, filtering and ranking; warm document index

E.scope: uncached full query parsing, candidate generation, filtering and ranking; warm document index

F.scope: uncached full query parsing, candidate generation, filtering and ranking; warm document index

release.selection_note: Development objective plus uncached dev p95 latency <50ms. No test labels or previous test metrics read.

feature_audit.provenance: Build reads corpus, catalog and source facts; never dev/test queries or relevance labels. No name-based visual inference, no part-to-outfit color inheritance.

environment.timing_scope: uncached warm in-memory parsing, candidate generation, filters and ranking; no loading/network/DOM

limitations: 人审数仍为0；同一批候选标签比较，不是正式Gold或随机用户样本。
测试正例仅4个家族，描述查询是同类结构化模板。
视觉颜色标注只覆盖部分部件；描述提及不是已证实图案元素。
推荐在开发集已确定，不按测试分数重新选型或调权。
